components.css: .ds-mat{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:36px;background:var(--mat);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}.ds-proof{position:relative;margin:0}.ds-img{width:200px;height:140px;background:var(--field);box-shadow:var(--shadow-proof)}.ds-proof::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-15px;--m:var(--ink-3);background:linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) left 0 top 15px/10px 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) left 15px top 0/1px 10px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) right 0 top 15px/10px 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) right 15px top 0/1px 10px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) left 0 bottom 15px/10px 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) left 15px bottom 0/1px 10px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) right 0 bottom 15px/10px 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--m),var(--m)) right 15px bottom 0/1px 10px no-repeat}.ds-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:10px;font:400 12.5px/1.35 var(--font-mono);color:var(--ink-2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-label::before{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--pink)}

narrative.overview: The app is a riso print-proofing table. Every generated image is a proof lying on a grey-blue mat, framed by crop marks, and never a dashboard card. The surface is light, cool paper with indigo-black ink. Two spot inks carry all meaning: pink says "act / generate", blue says "selected / focused / informational". Nothing else is saturated at size.
keyCharacteristics: Light theme only. No dark theme is implemented.
Pink and blue are the only chromatic voices; status colors are reserved for state.
Images have sharp corners; controls and panels have small-to-medium radii.
Measurements are set in tabular mono.
Compact density mode exists: control height 32px, gap 14px, pad 18px.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Pink is for doing, blue is for selecting. A control is never both. If something is saturated and large, it is Generate.

rules.name: The Mat Rule
rules.body: Images always sit on Mat (#dcdde1), never directly on Paper.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Measures Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only on numbers and identifiers, never as decoration on prose.

rules.name: The Paper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, low-contrast and ink-tinted. The only colored shadow is the Generate button's pink halo.

dos: Do frame every result image with the crop marks and place it on Mat (#dcdde1).
Do use Riso Pink only for Generate and primary actions; use Riso Blue for focus, selection and information.
Do set dimensions, seed, percentages and zoom in tabular mono.
Do keep image corners square and control radii at 3-6px; panels 14px.
Do keep shadows ink-tinted and low-contrast; use --shadow-proof for images.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and data-motion="reduce" (animations collapse to ~0ms).
donts: Don't return to a dark graphite surface or a cyan accent; that world was discarded.
Don't present results as a grid of identical dashboard cards in the main stage.
Don't make a second large saturated element next to Generate.
Don't use hard offset shadows, gradient text, or glow.
Don't put mono on prose or uppercase tracking on labels.
